ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$14.45 to the rider as Ryde voucher for the unmetered extra distance on the un-exempted detour segment (Seg A, Choa Chu Kang/Woodlands detour, 10.25 km at S$1.41/km); confirm the metered fare and the exempted AYE segment (Seg B) stand as charged.

segment_findings.reason: North-west detour off the AYE onto the Bukit Panjang / Choa Chu Kang / Woodlands corridor (GPS ~10:09–10:26), ~10.25 km beyond the quoted AYE route. Driver's chat consent (10:06:40) preceded only the general 'go round via Prince George's Park' proposal; the specific corridor taken, beyond the consented waypoint, was not agreed before the deviation (RD-5). No traffic fact supports it — the sole LTA incident (Vehicle breakdown, AYE, 1.31532/103.7594, 09:47) is far from this segment and AYE was band 5 (>50 km/h), so RD-4 fails. Un-exempted per RD-1 → refund of extra_km under RD-2.

AYE (Clementi) approach deviation (~10:00–10:03, ~1.4 km), where GPS runs ~1.4 km south of the quoted route on the AYE. Supported by the LTA incident 'Vehicle breakdown on Ayer Rajah Expressway' at 1.31532/103.7594 reported 09:47 (before this segment, still in the trip window) and the AYE speed-band record covering the trip — reasonable cause under RD-4(a); RD-1 exemption applies, no refund for this segment.
